snippet.title: Meet James!  |  Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor – Out Now!
snippet.description:
Introducing James! ❤️  

James has a fine scarlet coat and brass dome, and thinks of himself as a really splendid engine. Occasionally this leads to misguided ideas about the sort of work suitable for such a distinguished engine, invariably landing James in trouble. He will always put the situation right in the end, though. Players can help James and experience 4 additional scenarios as part of the Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor Deluxe Edition. 

Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of  Sodor is out  now on Steam, Epic Games, PlayStation and Xbox via https://bit.ly/Wonders-Of-Sodor-Launch-4
